python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# January 31, 1970
regular_1970 = 1501 + 13510 + 13516 + 16525 + 6308 + 6512 + 7721 + 1701 + 1505 + 1003 + 1001 + 1002
tax_1970 = 1752 + 3014 + 4508

# January 31, 1975
regular_1975 = 20916 + 20031 + 20328 + 14812 + 13517 + 14819 + 1803 + 1803 + 2003 + 2002 + 2001 + 2001
tax_1975 = 2251 + 1256

print(f"1970 - Regular weekly/annual maturing: {regular_1970}")
print(f"1970 - Tax anticipation: {tax_1970}")
print(f"1975 - Regular weekly/annual maturing: {regular_1975}")
print(f"1975 - Tax anticipation: {tax_1975}")

# Absolute changes
change_regular = regular_1975 - regular_1970
change_tax = tax_1975 - tax_1970

print(f"\nAbsolute change - Regular: {change_regular}")
print(f"Absolute change - Tax anticipation: {change_tax}")

# Euclidean norm
euclidean_norm = math.sqrt(change_regular**2 + change_tax**2)
print(f"\nEuclidean norm: {euclidean_norm}")
print(f"Euclidean norm (rounded to nearest hundredths): {round(euclidean_norm, 2)}")
EOF
